faqs.answer: Price depends on the system size and the brands. Reply *menu* to see our packages, or ask for a free quote and we will send a written price.
faqs.title: 💲 How much does it cost?

faqs.answer: A hybrid system keeps your lights, TV, fridge and Wi-Fi running during power cuts, using solar and battery. It can also use ZESA when available. Ask for a quote sized to the loads you want to keep on.
faqs.title: 🔌 ZESA & power cuts

faqs.answer: Lithium batteries last longer, are lighter and can be discharged deeper. Gel or lead-acid batteries cost less up front but need replacing sooner. We recommend based on your budget and how much power you use at night.
faqs.title: 🔋 Batteries

faqs.answer: We accept a deposit to book (typically 50-70%) with the balance on installation. Ask our team about payment plans.
faqs.title: 💳 Payment & deposit

faqs.answer: Panels: 10-25 year warranty. Inverters: 2-5 years. Batteries: 2-10 years depending on type. Installation workmanship: 12 months.
faqs.title: 🛡️ Warranty

faqs.answer: It depends on what you want to run. Tell us your appliances (fridge, TV, lights, borehole pump, geyser) and how many hours a day, and we will size the panels, inverter and battery for you. Reply *menu* and choose a quote.
faqs.title: 📐 How many panels?

faqs.answer: Yes, we can power a borehole pump with solar. We need the pump size (kW or HP), the depth and the daily water you need. A site visit confirms the best design.
faqs.title: 💧 Borehole pumps

faqs.answer: Installation usually takes 1-2 days after a site visit. A technician confirms panel placement, wiring and the right system size before we start.
faqs.title: 🔧 Installation time

faqs.answer: Fair question. Always ask any installer for company registration, past installations you can visit, brand warranty papers and a written quote. We are happy to share these. Reply *menu* to talk to our team.
faqs.title: ✅ Is it genuine?

faqs.answer: Geysers, stoves, heaters and air conditioners use a lot of power. They can run on solar, but they need a bigger system. Tell us what you want to run and we will size it. A solar geyser is often a cheaper option.
faqs.title: 🔥 Geyser, stove, aircon

faqs.answer: Hybrid inverters work with solar, battery and the grid. Off-grid systems run on solar and battery only. Grid-tie systems have no backup during a power cut. For homes with outages we usually recommend hybrid.
faqs.title: ⚙️ Inverter types

faqs.answer: Batteries store power for the night and cloudy periods. Panels still make some power on cloudy days, just less.
faqs.title: 🌙 Night & cloudy days

faqs.answer: Savings depend on how much you spend on power and fuel now. Many customers recover the cost within a few years. Share your monthly electricity or generator spend and we will estimate it.
faqs.title: 📈 Savings & payback

faqs.answer: A technician visits to check the roof, shade, wiring and your loads, then confirms the system size. Reply *menu* to book a visit or request a quote.
faqs.title: 📋 Site visit

faqs.answer: Panels work best facing north with little shade. Most roof types work. We check the roof and shade at the site visit and mount the panels at the best angle.
faqs.title: 🏠 Roof & shade

faqs.answer: Panels typically last 25 years or more. Inverters often last 8-12 years. Batteries last roughly 3-5 years for gel and 8-10 years for lithium, depending on use.
faqs.title: ⏳ How long it lasts

faqs.answer: Solar needs very little care: rinse panels now and then and have the system checked once a year. We offer service plans.
faqs.title: 🧽 Maintenance

faqs.answer: We supply quality panels, inverters and batteries from well-known brands. The exact brands depend on the package and stock. Ask for a quote and we will list every item and its warranty.
faqs.title: 🏷️ Brands

faqs.answer: Reply *menu* and choose to speak to our team, and we will share our contact details and arrange a call or visit.
faqs.title: 📍 Contact & location
🛠️ Our services
faqs.answer: GieBee Engineering installs solar systems (hybrid inverters with lithium batteries), solar borehole and water pumping, electrical wiring, CCTV and alarm systems, and solar geysers. Tell me what you need and I will arrange a quotation.

faqs.title: 💧 Solar water pumping
faqs.answer: Yes, we install solar borehole pumping. A complete installation (DC submersible pump, solar panels, cabling and installation) is typically about USD 790 for 0.75HP, USD 1,050 for 1HP, USD 1,550-1,590 for 1.5-2HP and USD 1,760 for 3HP. A 5,000L tank is about USD 345 and a 3m tank stand about USD 260 extra. The exact price depends on the borehole depth and distance, so tell me the depth, how much water you need per day and where you are, and we will quote.

faqs.title: 🔋 Component prices
faqs.answer: Our current prices (USD, equipment only): solar panels 450W about 75, 550W about 90, 590W about 105. Lithium batteries 12V 100Ah about 235, 25.6V 100Ah about 360, 5.12kWh about 650-700, 10kWh about 1,670. Hybrid inverters 1kVA about 120, 3.2kVA about 180, 5kVA and 6.2kVA about 325, 10kVA about 870-950. Mounting, protection kit and installation are extra. Tell me what you need and I will quote.

faqs.title: 📋 What's in a quote?
faqs.answer: Our systems are quoted complete: hybrid inverter, lithium battery, solar panels, mounting kit, protection kit (breakers and surge protection), cabling and installation labour. Labour is usually USD 150-200, transport USD 60-150 depending on distance, the mounting kit USD 90-150 and the protection kit USD 60-70. The final price is confirmed in a written quotation.

faqs.title: 📹 CCTV & security
faqs.answer: Yes, we install CCTV and alarm systems. Most CCTV installations are quoted at around USD 800, and small ones start from about USD 200, depending on the number of cameras, the recorder, the screen and the cabling. Tell me how many cameras and where, and we will send a quotation.

faqs.title: 🔌 Electrical work
faqs.answer: Yes, we do wiring for houses and buildings: DB boards, sockets, switches and lighting. Electrical jobs are usually quoted at around USD 670, and small jobs start from about USD 120, depending on size. Tell me the type of building and the number of rooms, or send a plan, and we will quote.

faqs.title: 🚿 Solar geysers
faqs.answer: Yes, we install solar geysers. Installations are typically USD 700-1,400 depending on the tank size and your roof. Tell me the geyser size and where you are and we will quote.
